newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister, business leaders visit China.
newsitem.headline: French minister, business leaders visit China.

text.p: French Transport Minister Bernard Pons travels to China on Saturday for a four-day visit to try to win big business contracts, the government announced on Friday.
A delegation of 20 business leaders will accompany Pons, the second French cabinet member to visit Beijing this year who was invited by Chinese Communications Minister Huang Zhendong.

Pons, also with portfolios of equipment, housing and tourism in the government, is scheduled to meet Chinese cabinet members and senior officials in the planning, aviation, communications, railways and construction sectors, his ministry said.
The last French official to visit Beijing was Foreign Minister Herve de Charette in March.
In April, Chinese Prime Minister Li Deng visisted France in in a visit marked by human rights protests and a diplomatic clash as well as the signing of several major business deals with French firms.
After Li Peng's visit, a European consortium including France, Britain and Italy agreed to build a 100-seater passenger plane for the Asian market in China .

Towards the end of his visit, Li Peng insisted on cancelling the toasts at a state dinner in his honour after French Prime Minister Alain Juppe disclosed he would refer in his remarks to the contentious human rights issue.
